thread.title: Here's What You Need To Know About The Spotify IPO

author: BRIAN DEAGON
title: Here's What You Need To Know About The Spotify IPO
text:
Spotify Technology ( SPOT ), one of the most highly anticipated initial public offerings this year, is expected to begin trading Tuesday.
X
The company says it's the largest global music streaming subscription service. It has 159 million monthly active users and 71 million subscribers for its premium service package.
Spotify believes it's nearly double the scale of its closest competitor, Apple ( AAPL ) with its Apple Music platform, according to its IPO prospectus . Apple Music recently disclosed having 38 million paying subscribers.
Its other competitors include Google Play Music, owned by Alphabet ( GOOGL ), as well as Pandora ( P ) and Amazon 's ( AMZN ) Amazon Music platform. Alphabet is reportedly picking a fight with Apple, Pandora and Spotify with a new music streaming service, after squaring off with Amazon.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Spotify reported revenue of $4.99 billion in 2017, up 38% from the prior year. It had an operating loss of $461 million, up from a $426 million loss in 2016.
Luxembourg-based Spotify expects to have 198 million to 208 million monthly active users by the end of 2018, including paid and free users, an increase of about 29% from the year-ago period. It expects 2018 revenue in the range of $6.1 billion to $6.8 billion.
Orders Set The Price The offering is an uncommon one. Spotify is using a direct listing approach that allows it avoid the process of having bankers set the initial price of the shares through a typical order book creation. As a direct listing, its opening public price will be determined by orders collected from broker-dealers.
The company plans to offer up to 55.7 million ordinary shares.
In the company's prospectus, Spotify says no public market for its ordinary shares currently exists. But the shares have a history of trading in private transactions. In its latest updated filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on March 23, Spotify said that from Jan. 1 through March 9, shares traded privately in a price range of 48.93 to 132.50.
Its public market valuation will be set just before the stock lists. That will be based on the number of shares existing investors want to sell, demand for those shares and agreed-upon price. As of March 9, Spotify had 183.6 million ordinary shares outstanding.
Spotify Valuation Range Last year Spotify's valuation ranged up to $20.9 billion. Its current market valuation has an estimated range of $15.9 billion to $23.4 billion.
On Thursday, Spotify was initiated with an outperform rating by RBC Capital Markets analyst Mark Mahaney. Mahaney put a price target on the shares of 220, saying the streaming music leader has a sustainable advantage.
"We believe that Spotify has established a clear leadership position," Mahaney wrote in a research note to clients.
Coverage initiations of companies that have not yet gone public is rare, but it does happen with high-profile offerings.
Apple shares on the stock market today were up 2.9%, near 171.35. Amazon shares were up 1.5%, near 1,451.
